companies.name: ユニオン・パシフィック

relations.text: 石炭の鉄道輸送契約により、アーカンソー州向けの鉄道輸送需要をすべて担う見込みである
relations.text_en: Union Pacific's agreement is expected to cover all of Entergy Arkansas's rail transportation requirements for 2026

source.label: エンタジー 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Coal will be transported to Arkansas via an existing Union Pacific transportation agreement that is expected to provide all of Entergy Arkansas’s rail transportation requirements for 2026.

relations.text: アーカンソー州ウェストメンフィスの大規模データセンターへの電力販売契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Google has a contract with Entergy Arkansas for electricity to a new large-scale data center in West Memphis, Arkansas

source.label: エンタジー 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: (Google) and Entergy Arkansas for the sale of electricity to a new large-scale data center in West Memphis, Arkansas.

companies.name: アマゾン・ドット・コム(AWS)

relations.text: ミシシッピ州の2か所のデータセンター用地に供給する大口需要家契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Entergy Mississippi signed a large customer supply agreement for two data center campuses in which Amazon Web Services is investing

source.label: エンタジー 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In March 2024, Entergy Mississippi executed a large customer supply and service agreement to serve two data centers campuses located in Madison County, Mississippi in which Amazon Web Services is investing.

companies.name: メタ・プラットフォームズ

relations.text: ルイジアナ州北部の新データセンター向けに電力サービス契約を締結している
relations.text_en: An electric service agreement has been executed for a new Meta data center in north Louisiana

source.label: エンタジー 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In October 2024, Entergy Louisiana filed an application with the LPSC seeking approval of a variety of generation and transmission resources proposed in connection with establishing service to a new data center to be developed by a subsidiary of Meta Platforms, Inc. in north Louisiana, for which an electric service agreement has been executed.
